summary: Restore floating-point parsing of surrounding ASCII whitespace and reject duplicated signs.
explanation: NumbersTest.Atod asserts that SimpleAtod("  3.141  ", &d) returns true; it currently returns false because SimpleAtod strips leading whitespace but passes trailing spaces to from_chars, then requires the entire input to be consumed. NumbersTest.Prefixes asserts that SimpleAtod("+-1", &d) and SimpleAtof("+-1", &f) return false; both currently return true because they skip the initial '+' and then accept the remaining '-1'. Trim ASCII whitespace at both ends in both parsers and reject a sign immediately following a skipped '+'.
